title: Indian Dams, Ports, Airports, and Power Plants: Quiz

questions.question: The Tehri Dam, the tallest dam in India, is built on which river?
questions.rationale: Tehri stands on the Bhagirathi in Uttarakhand. The Sutlej is the Bhakra river, a frequent swap.

questions.question: The reservoir of the Bhakra Dam is called:
questions.rationale: Bhakra's reservoir is Gobind Sagar. Maharana Pratap Sagar belongs to Pong (Beas), Stanley to Mettur, and G.B. Pant Sagar to Rihand.

questions.question: Hirakud Dam is built across which river?
questions.rationale: Hirakud is on the Mahanadi in Odisha. The Narmada carries Sardar Sarovar and Indira Sagar instead.

questions.question: Which of the following dam-river-state matches is correct?
questions.rationale: Idukki is an arch dam on the Periyar in Kerala. Sardar Sarovar is in Gujarat and Indira Sagar in Madhya Pradesh, so the first two swap states, and Mettur is on the Cauvery in Tamil Nadu.

questions.question: Which of these dams is NOT located on the Chambal river?
questions.rationale: The Chambal project has Gandhi Sagar, Rana Pratap Sagar and Jawahar Sagar. Nagarjuna Sagar is on the Krishna.

questions.question: The Kallanai (Grand Anicut), among the oldest water-regulation structures still in use, is on which river?
questions.rationale: Kallanai is on the Cauvery in Tamil Nadu and is credited to the Chola king Karikalan.

questions.question: Which Indian major port is the only riverine one, standing on the Hooghly?
questions.rationale: Kolkata (Syama Prasad Mookerjee Port) is the riverine port. Kandla is a tidal port on the Gulf of Kutch.

questions.question: Which major port was renamed Deendayal Port in 2017?
questions.rationale: Kandla in Gujarat became Deendayal Port. Ennore is Kamarajar Port and Tuticorin is V.O. Chidambaranar Port.

questions.question: Which Tamil Nadu port is an artificial harbour on the east coast and also a major port?
questions.rationale: Chennai is an artificial harbour. Visakhapatnam and Mumbai are natural harbours, and Kolkata is a river port.

questions.question: Which port was commissioned in 1989 as Nhava Sheva and is the main container port among the major ports?
questions.rationale: JNPA in Maharashtra, near Mumbai, is the chief container port of the government's major ports.

questions.question: Which statement about ports is correct?
options: Mundra is a government major port in Tamil Nadu
Vadhavan was approved as a major port in Maharashtra in 2024
Cochin is on the east coast
questions.rationale: The Union Cabinet approved the Vadhavan port (Palghar, Maharashtra) in June 2024. Mundra is private and in Gujarat, Cochin is on the west coast, and Mormugao is in Goa.

questions.question: Which airport in India is named after Gopinath Bordoloi and located in Assam?
questions.rationale: Guwahati's airport is Lokpriya Gopinath Bordoloi International Airport.

questions.question: Match the airport with its city: Kempegowda International.
questions.rationale: Kempegowda International is in Bengaluru. Rajiv Gandhi International is in Hyderabad, the one most often swapped with it.

questions.question: Which Indian airport was the first built under a public-private partnership and in 2015 became fully solar-powered?
questions.rationale: Cochin International Airport (opened 1999) pioneered the PPP model and became the first fully solar-powered airport in 2015.

questions.question: Which was India's first nuclear power station, started in 1969?
questions.rationale: Tarapur in Maharashtra began in 1969. Kudankulam is the largest nuclear station, not the first.
